prefixCoefficient_eq_sum:
theorem prefixCoefficient_eq_sum (z : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixCoefficient z t = ∑ i ∈ range t, z i
linearFTLPredict_prefix:
theorem linearFTLPredict_prefix (z w : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : ℝ) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i < t, z i = w i) : linearFTLPredict z x0 t = linearFTLPredict w x0 t
linearFTLPredict_mem:
theorem linearFTLPredict_mem (z : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : ℝ) (hx0 : x0 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (t : ℕ) : linearFTLPredict z x0 t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
linearFTLPredict_minimizes:
theorem linearFTLPredict_minimizes (z : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : ℝ) (t : ℕ)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∑ i ∈ range t, z i * linearFTLPredict z x0 t) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, z i * u
failure_prefixCoefficient:
theorem failure_prefixCoefficient (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    prefixCoefficient failureCoefficient t = if t % 2 = 1 then -(1/2) else (1/2)
failure_prediction:
theorem failure_prediction (x0 : ℝ) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    linearFTLPredict failureCoefficient x0 t = if t % 2 = 1 then 1 else -1
example_2_10:
theorem example_2_10 (x0 : ℝ) (hx0 : x0 ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, failureCoefficient t * linearFTLPredict failureCoefficient x0 t) -
      (∑ t ∈ range T, failureCoefficient t * (0 : ℝ)) = (T : ℝ) - 1 - x0 / 2 ∧
    (T : ℝ) - 3/2 ≤
      (∑ t ∈ range T, failureCoefficient t * linearFTLPredict failureCoefficient x0 t) -
        (∑ t ∈ range T, failureCoefficient t * (0 : ℝ))
